tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gi chu bo dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug ca
༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gi chu bo dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug ca

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gi chu bo dngos grub 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis lus dkyil gyi dbang chog dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam med rnam pa kun ldan 'khor lo lnga// gdod nas yongs grub rdo rje'i lus dkyil du// skal bzang blo can tshogs rnams smin mdzad pa// grub chen dril bu zhabs kyis bdag skyongs shig /de yang*/ dril bu zhabs kyis/ bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pa'i bsgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor grub// dkyil 'khor lha rnams grub pa'o// de yi dbang bskur la sogs rim/ */ ci nas ma grub kyang grub byed// de yi rang bzhin mi shes rnams// snod du bya bar bzhed pa ste// dbang bskur sogs rim kun rdzob tu// mngon sum du ni sgrub pa'o| |zhes rdul tshon dang tshom bu ste bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis ni dbang po 'bring dang tha ma'i 'dul bya'i dbang yin la/ dbang rnon mkhas pa dag gi bsgrub bya ni de dag min gyi yang dag pa'i don mthong nas grol ba'i phyir/ 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor gdod nas rdo rje'i lus la grub pa ngo sprad de dbang bskur bas dkyil 'khor pa rnams grub par byed la/ de yang dbang bskur bas ci nas ma grub pa'i rdzogs rim rim pa lnga po yang grub byed yin zhing*/ de yang rdzogs rim de lta bu mi shes pa rnams snod du bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur ba la sogs pa'i rim pa kun rdzob go yul du ma lus par gdod ma'i ye shes mngon sum du de'i rgyud la sgrub par byed pa'i thabs dam pa'o// de lta bu'i dbang la gnyis/ dbye ba bskur thabs so// dang po ni/ dril zhabs kyis/

slob dpon la sogs dbye ba yis// dbang bskur rim pa bzhir bshad de// chu yi dbang sogs dbye ba yis// bzhi po de ni bcu bzhi'o// zhes pa ni/ slob dpon gyi dbang dang 'brel ba bum dbang*/ dbang gong ma gsum dang bzhi yin la/ slob dpon gyi dbang yang chu dbang sogs kyi dbye bas dbang bzhi po de yang bcu bzhir dbyer rung zhes pa ste rnam gzhag mdor bsdus tsam mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ nyer bsdogs/ sgrub mchod/ dbang bskur dngos so// dang po ni/ tshad dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis kha rgyan mgul chings dang bcas pa'i nang lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ chang*/ 'o ma chu rnams bsres pas sum gnyis bkang ba'i rnam rgyal gyi steng du dung zhal dang*/ de steng rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba btags pa yang bzhag /bum mtshan rnam rgyal sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su gtso bo yab yum gyi phyag mtshan dag gam sa bon/ las bum la sna tshogs pad nyi'i dbus su gri gug gam paṃ yig bri'o// de dag la chu bzhi sogs kyi mchod pa sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar dang*/ rigs lnga/ rdor dril/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /tshangs skud/ mig thur/ mig dar/ me tog /mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma la sogs pa dbang gi rdzas ma tshang ba med pa dang*/ gzhan yang yo byad tshogs gtor sogs sgrub thabs nas bshad pa ltar bkod legs par bshams/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar grub rjes/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gnyis kyi nang du oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swā hā/ zhes bgrangs pa'i lha'i chu gaṅgā'i ngo bos gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i ze'u 'brur nyi ma dang*/ zhes pa nas/ gnyis su med par snyoms par zhugs pa'o// zhes pa ltar lus phyi'i he ru kar bskyed pa'i skabs ltar bya/ he ru ka de lta bu'i klad pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su haṃ yig dkar po zhes pa nas/

rnal 'byor ma bzhi ltar gsal bar gyur gyi bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ las bum gyi nang du sna tshogs pad nyir paṃ las dum skyes ma dmar mo zhal gcig pa spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa zhes pa nas/ g.yon bskums pas gnas pa zhes pa'i bar mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i skabs ltar bskyed/ de nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po zhes pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar la/ dbang bskur gyi skabs bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes pa dor la/ 'di rnams la mngon par zhes dang*/ rgyas 'debs kyi tshe sgo mtshams ma la don grub/ dum skyes ma la rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan/ zhes dang*/ dbang lha rnams de rnams la thim par gyur/ ces 'don pa bsgyur ro// de nas/ hūm̐/ zhes gzung thag lag g.yon pa'i mtheb srin dril bu dang bcas pas bzung la/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng thon gzung thag la brgyud de song ba bum pa'i lha gtso 'khor gyi thugs kar reg pas yab yum thams cad snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar sbyor mtshams nas thon pas bum pa gang bar gyur par dmigs nas/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags sgrub thabs ltar la/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes btags pa ci nus bzlas so// de nas me tog dang bcas pa las bum gyi khar spos la/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sogs ci 'grub bzla/ mthar rnam rgyal gyi steng gi dung chu mchod yon du phul nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyi sngags brjod/ me tog dkar po bdun gyis mchod la/ lha rnams chags pa chen po'i ngo bor zhu ba bum chu dang ro gcig tu gyur bar dmigs la nyer spyod lngas mchod/ las bum gyi lha mi bzhu bar/ dum skyes mas 'dir ji srid dbang gi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs rnams zlog par mdzod cig /ces phrin las bcol/ las thams cad pa'i bum chu nas rnam rgyal la 'thor zhing las sngags kyis bsrungs/

rnam rgyal gyi chu cung zad dung chos su bstsal ba mna' chu'i ched du rnam rgyal gyi steng du bzhag go// skabs 'dir 'das dang ma 'das pa'i gtor ma sgrub thabs ltar bya'o// de nas bdag 'jug ni/ rang gi lus dkyil las dkyil 'khor gnyis pa spros pa nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gtso bos slob dpon gyi bya ba mdzad par bsams la/ 'og nas bshad pa ltar bdag 'jug rgyas par blang*/ tshul 'di ni bdag mdun dbyer med du bya ba'i gnad dam pa yin no// de nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste| |gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges 'byung ba// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum brjod la/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams rang gi lus dkyil dang dbyer med du gyur| oṃ badz+ra he ru ka ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra swa bhā wa bi shud+dhaḥ.āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gsum pa dbang bskur dngos la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ mjug go// dang po sbyor ba la gnyis/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas te 'jug pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du 'jug pa'o// dang po sdom ni/ gsol gdab chas gzhug byin brlab cing*// rgyun bshags sdom pa bsgrag cing gzung*// dris lan sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// phyag mtshan phan yon nyes dmigs dang*// gnyis ka bka' gnyan dam la bzhag /byin 'bebs brtan byas kha dog dri// smon lam dag dang bco brgyad do// dang po ni/ slob ma las bum gyi chus khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs chod mdzod la// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid grub par mdzod// ces gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

gnyis pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra was+t+ra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐ gis smad g.yogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ gis stod g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra uṣ+ṇī ṣa hūm̐ gis gtsug tor/ oṃ tsak+ṣurbahan+dha wa ra mā na ya hūm̐ gis bzla sngags btab pa'i gdong g.yogs/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gis me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ gsum pa/ slob ma'i snying gar rdo rje nag po'i lte bar nyi ma la hūm̐ nag po/ mgrin par pad+ma dmar po'i lte bar zla ba la āḥdamar po/ dpral bar 'khor lo dkar po'i lte bar zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ de dag gi 'od kyis lus 'od gsal bar byas pa hūm̐ zhes brjod la/ lus dkyil gyi shar sgor 'khod par gyur par mos/ bzhi pa/ slob mas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// sogs gsum brjod/ lnga pa/ slob dpon dang ni lhag pa'i lha// khyod kyis smad par mi bya zhing*// dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste// dmyal la sogs par 'gro bar 'gyur| |zhes brjod/ drug pa/ slob mas de 'dzin 'dod kyi bsam pas/ sangs rgyas sras bcas sogs gsum brjod/ bdun pa/ slob dpon gyis/ kye/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'// zhes dri/ slob mas/ skal bzang bdag ni bde ba chen po la'o// yang bla mas/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// slob mas/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go// zhes brjod/ brgyad pa/ slob ma'i snying khar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dal nya yongs su gang ba'i dbus su don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro bas mtshan pa re gsal bar bsgoms la/ slob mas/ oṃ badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ zhes brjod/ bla mas rdo rje me tog dang bcas pa bu'i snying khar reg la/ oṃ su ra te sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥ sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brtan par bya/ dgu pa/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyi/

khyod kyis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchog tu gsang ba dam pa'i dal 'di lta bur ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya zhing ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// zhes brjod/ bcu pa/ slob mas thal mo spyi bor sbyar nas/ oṃ na maḥte hūm̐/ mgrin par/ na maḥmi hūm̐/ snying khar/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ slar slob dpon lhar gsal ba la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni skyabs su mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo// rnal 'byor gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal// zhes gsum dang*/ snying ga sa la reg pa'i phyag gsum bya/ bcu gcig pa/ slob ma'i mgo bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi des na ngas khyod la rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gi khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis kyang 'di dal ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ bcu gnyis pa/ rdo rje mgor bzhag dril bu gsil zhing*/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di// gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la// 'di smras na ni spyi bo 'gems// zhes dang*/ rdo rje snying khar bzung la/ dpal he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod/ bcu gsum pa/ dung zhal gyi dri chu dang thod pa'i chang bsres par yi ge gsum dang*/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tod ka ṭha bdun bzlas pa blud cing*/ 'di ni bu khyod bdud rtsi ste// ma bsrung sreg par byed pa'i dug /bsrungs na dngos grub 'gyur ba ste// bdud rtsi lnga yi chu grub pa'o// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ tod ka ṭha ṭha ṭhaḥ zhes byin/ bcu bzhi pa/ rdo rje dang bcas pas bu'i lag pa nas bzung la/

deng nas bzung ste khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di gyis shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas par mi bya ste/ de byas na khyod ya nga ba ma spang bar 'chi ba'i dus byas nas rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bsgrags/ bco lnga pa/ slob mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs la/ dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bdag la dbab tu gsol/ gsum brjod/ dpon slob gnyis ka g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis/ slob ma bcom ldan 'das su gsal ba'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i slob dpon gyi lus la gnas pa'i sku gsung thugs dam tshig bde ba chen po ste/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad mar me gcig las gnyis mched ltar spros pa ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thon te/ slob ma rnams kyi ba spu'i khung bu rnams su zhugs nas rtsa khams so so'i dam tshig pa la thim zhing gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor bcas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas slob ma'i lus la sib sib thim par dpon slob gnyis kas bsam zhing*/ bud med kyi 'doms dkris kyi ras bshang gci dang zla mtshan bdud rtsi lngas sbags pa dang*/ byi la'i brun/ gu gul nag po rnams bud med kyi thod pa'i nang du ro sol gyi me la bsregs pa'i dud pas slob ma rnams bdug cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ yab yum gyi snying po dang*/ nye snying gi mthar/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ shrī he ru kā ya bid+ma he bid+yā rā dzā ya dhīḥm he swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags rnam pa brgyar 'don cing*/ ḍā dril rol mo dang bcas pas dbab/ de las sku bab na gar byed pa dang*/ gsung bab na sngags sgra sgrog pa dang*/ thugs bab na lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa skye ba sogs 'byung*/ bcu drug pa/ bu'i spyi bor rdo rje bzhag cing*/

tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brjod/ bcu bdun pa/ khyod kyi mig lam ji ltar snang*// zhes dri/ des/ dkar ser dmar ljang khra bo gang mthong ba ltar/ bla mas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs 'grub pa'i skal pa can du go ba bskyed/ bco brgyad pa/ slob ma rnams kyis g.yon skor byas nas shar du 'dug la/ slob dpon gyis/ yang dag gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du// bdag gis slob ma bcug pa 'di// lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa ni// bsod nams ji lta de ltar shog /'di yi dngos grub ji 'drar 'gyur// rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba// de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces smon lam gdab bo// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i bdag nyid can du 'jug pa ni/ me tog dor zhing mgo bor sbyin// mig dbye bstan cing lha ngo sprad// ces pa las/ dang po/ sngar gtad pa'i me tog gi phreng ba trāṃ gis sngags pa thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi 'od kyis slob ma'i lus 'od gsal zhing sdig pa bkrus par bsam la/ slob mas/ he ru ka dpal dkyil 'khor 'dir// rig pa'i me tog 'di dor bas// sngon tshe gang la sbyangs pa'i lha// gang yin de la phog par shog /pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor la dor bas/ de yang slob dpon gyi thugs kar phog na gtso bo ste mchog gi dngos grub thob/ gnas so sor lha gang yin pa de nyid 'grub cing*/ gnyis la nye ring med na gnyis ka dang*/ mtshams su na gang la nye ba de nyid 'grub/ phyir lhung na lan gsum bskyar zhing de yang phyir lhung na dngos grub phra mo tsam thob/ slob dpon gyi sku las phyi rol gzhan du yar na dngos grub med par lung bstan to// gnyis pa/ me tog de nyid sngar gyi phreng ba dang gcig tu byas pa slob ma'i mgor bcings la/ sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar mdzod// oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/

zhes me tog phog pa'i lha de la slob ma gtad pas rjes su bzung bar bsams/ gsum pa/ slob ma'i snying khar nyi ma la hūm̐/ dpral bar raṃ/ mig gnyis su 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i oṃ re gsal bar mos la/ bla mas/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ zhes gser gyi thur mas mig dbye ba'i rgyas gdong g.yogs bkrol/ bzhi pa/ slob dpon gyis/ he badz+ra/ zhes bos nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang*// grub kun khyod la mngon du gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub par gyis// zhes bsgo| lnga pa/ slob dpon gyis/ rang bzhin gyi ni dag pa'i bdag /lus ni rang bzhin dri ma med// gtso dang dpa' bo dbang mo'i gnas// dkyil 'khor lha ni bu khyod ltos// de nas gnas dang nye gnas sogs// bdag nyid dkyil 'khor lus dkyil 'khor// der gnas byang chub phyogs kyi chos// sum cu rtsa bdun rang bzhin te// rtsa ni sum cu rtsa bdun po// lha yi 'khor lo dkyil 'khor pa// dpal ldan he ru ka yi ni// yan lag yan lag nyer bsten bya// zhes dang*/ slar/ hoḥ rigs kyi bu rnams rang rang gi lus la ye gdod ma nas rtsa khams dpa' bo dpa' mo'i rang bzhin du gnas pa gdod nas yongs su grub pa ni 'di lta ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus lha'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab kyi dbus rtsa a wa dhū ti'i nang du dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro ma dra ba sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa ni/ haṃ yig kha ba lta bu 'dzag pa snying khar bab pa 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/

yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni rgod ma'i me dang mtshungs pa'i dmar cha steng du 'bar ba snying gar 'phrad pa yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i mdun chu rlung sgyu ma'i rtsa lam las mkha' 'gro ma mthing ga zhes pa nas/ sku mdog dkar po'o zhes dang*/ snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa 'dab brgyad dang hūm̐ ring po brgyad gnyis su med pa las zhes pa nas/ de ltar dam tshig 'khor lo'i lha mo brgyad dang bcas pa ste/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rang gi lus la gdod ma nas gnas pa ni gdod nas yongs su grub pa gzhan nas tshol du med pa'i chos nyid du rtogs par gyis shig /ces bstan cing ngo sprad do// dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ bum dbang*/ gsang dbang*/ sher dbang*/ tshig dbang dang bzhi'o// dang po la'ang*/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang ngo*// dang po la lnga/ chu/ cod pan/ rdo rje/ dril bu/ ming dbang ngo*// dang po ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ chos bden bdag nyid bsam mi khyab// bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol// zhes gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis bum pa mang po yod na chu rnams rnam rgyal du bsdus pa'am/ gnyis las med na rnam rgyal mdun du bzhag la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer slob ma'i lus la phog pas slob ma 'od du zhu ba hūm̐ gi rnam par gyur pa slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud snying ga'i he ru ka'i zhal du zhugs pa sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mar bab pa dhū ti'i lam nas yab kyi rdo rje'i rtse mor son pa mdun du spros pa dbang stegs rdo rje dang seng ges bteg pa'i khrir gnas pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du 'khor bar bsam/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/

dbang rdzas bum chu hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las skyes pa'i mi bskyod pa 'khor lo sdom pa mthing nag /zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas pa drug rdo rje/ g.yon pa drug de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ pad nyir brkyang bskum gyis bsgyings pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur zhing rang rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu nas dbang rdzas bum chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang lha 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ bcom ldan 'das kyis dbang gi dgongs pa mdzad/ phag mo la sogs pa yum lngas ye shes kyi bum pa byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ slob dpon gyis bum pa thogs nas/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po ni| |khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ tsakra bī ra s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes mgor bzhag cing bum chu blud/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur bas lus thams cad gang*/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa myong*/ dri ma dag /chu lhag ma gyen du 'khyil ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha rnams slob ma'i ba spu'i sgo nas bstims pas gnyis su med par gyur/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de dag gis chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang gi dri ma sbyangs| rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/ gnyis pa/ dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bcas pa sngar ltar bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/ dbang rdzas dbu rgyan aṃ las rin po che ser po aṃ gis mtshan pa las skyes pa'i rin chen 'byung ldan 'khor lo sdom pa ser po/ zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas pa drug rin po che dang*/ g.yon pa drug de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu sogs la/ yum rin chen sgrol ma/ dbang rdzas bum chu'i mal du dbu rgyan zhes 'don pa spos la/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa'i// rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs cod pan gyi ni dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇa nī ye huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes dbu rgyan bskon la/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis dar dpyangs bcings/ slar/ oṃ badz+rod ka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ gis chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus sogs nas/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan sogs mchod pa'i bar bya/ de dag gis cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba thob| nga rgyal dang ser sna'i dri ma sbyangs/ tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// gsum pa/ rdo rje dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/

dbang rdzas dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dmar po dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las skyes pa'i snang ba mtha' yas 'khor lo sdom pa dmar po/ zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas pa drug pad+ma dang*/ g.yon pa drug de'i yu ba byas pa'i dril bu sogs la/ yum gos dkar mo/ chu'i mal du rdo rje zhes spos la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje yi// dbang ni de ring khyod rab bskur// de bzhin sangs rgyas thams cad nyid| |rab tu bsgrub phyir rdo rje zung*// a dhi pa ti twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ bī ra shrī he ru ka de wī i daṃ tut+sarba bud+dha s+t+waṃ gṛh+ṇa badz+ra su sid+dha ye/ zhes rdo rje bu'i snying mgrin dpral bar reg la lag g.yas su sbyin/ oṃ badz+rod kas chu dbang skur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chu sogs nas/ snang ba mtha' yas kyis dbu brgyan sogs mchod pa'i bar bya/ de dag gis rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags kyi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du shes kyi phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// bzhi pa/ dril bu dang slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/ dbang rdzas dril bu dang khaṃ las ral gri ljang gu khaṃ gis mtshan pa las skyes pa'i don yod grub pa 'khor lo sdom pa ljang gu/ zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas pa drug ral gri dang*/ g.yon pa drug de'i yu ba byas pa'i sogs la/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma/ chu'i mal du dril bu zhes spos/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis// dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*/ byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti twaṃ| a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes g.yon du gtad la/ des kyang dkrol zhing*/ dpa' bo lag tu rdo rje dril// bzung ngo 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag

/rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni| |phyag rgya chen por byin gyis brlabs// zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+rod kas chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan sogs mchod pa'i bar bya/ de dag gis dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog gi dri ma sbyangs/ 'du byed kyi phung po gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// lnga pa/ slob ma dang rdor dril bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma dang*/ dbang rdzas rdor dril buṃ las 'khor lo dkar po bum gyis mtshan pa las skyes pa'i rnam par snang mdzad 'khor lo sdom pa dkar po/ zhal bzhi/ phyag bcu gnyis pa/ g.yas pa drug 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon pa drug de'i yu ba byas pa'i sogs la/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma/ chu'i mal du rdo rje dang dril bu mnyam par spyi bor bzung nas sogs rdor dril spyi bor thogs la/ rdo rje ming gi dbang bskur bas// rtag pa'i rdo rje rab zhugs te// mi shigs rdo rje'i ming ldan par// bu khyod de ring dbang bskur ro// oṃ shrī tsakra a dhi pa ti shrī he ru ka bī ra s+t+waṃ/ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ zhes dang*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal bzhad pa'i rdo rje'am/ rol pa'i rdo rje'am/ zhe sdang rdo rje'am/ me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming btags la/ che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o zhes dang*/ oṃ badz+rod kas chu dbang bskur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i sogs nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan sogs mchod pa'i bar bya/ de dag gis ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug gi dri ma sbyangs/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur| me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon dang bag chags rgyud la bzhag /rigs 'di nyid kyi dngos grub dang phrin las bsgrub pa la dbang bar byas so// dbang 'di dag gis spang bya ma rig pa sogs nyon mongs pa lnga spong zhing*/

thob bya ye shes lnga thob par byed pas na rig pa'i dbang zhes bya zhing*/ 'di thob nas bya spyod kyi rgyud mtha' dag la nyan bshad dang sngags bsgrub pa la dbang ba yin no// zhes go ba sbyin no// gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang ni/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa/ dbang dngos/ mtha' rten no// dang po ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che// dpa' bo chen pos bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir bstsal du gsol// gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du slob ma dbang stegs seng ge'i khrir pad zla'i gdan la rdo rje sems dpa' sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa'i pang du/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa gnyis ka'ang*/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur par dmigs la/ rdo rje hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba ste// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ */rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag */bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog gi bdag po'i skyes bu'o// zhes g.yas su gtad/ slob mas/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing gsor bas snying gar bzung*/ dril bu aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces g.yon tu sbyin| slob mas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' che// dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ṭa hoḥ zhes brjod cing dkrol| de nas slob mas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas la/

slob dpon gyis/ yid kyi lus ni brtan bya'i phyir// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su brjod// des na phyag rgyar rab tu grags// ye shes phyag rgyar byin brlabs nas// 'dod pa thams cad longs spyad de// dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes brjod/ gnyis pa/ dbang dngos gzhi ni/ slob ma rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba rdor dril dang bcas pas yum rdo rje snyems ma la 'khyud cing snyoms par zhugs pas bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsam zhing 'khyud tshul bya/ slob dpon gyis/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la| |lag pa dag ni yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung zhig rdo rjer byin brlabs pas// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis// zhes slob dpon bgyi ba'i gnang ba byin la/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis dbang gi lha 'khor lo sdom pa lha drug cu rtsa gnyis zhes pa nas/ bsnams nas dbang bskur bar bsam gyi bar bum dbang ltar dang*/ bum pa thogs ste/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// dpa' bo dag gi rnal 'byor gnas// ci ltar 'dod pas mchod byas pa// gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ gis dbang bskur/ de ltar bdud rtsi'i chus dbang bskur zhes pa nas/ nyer spyod kyi bar chu dbang gi skabs ltar bya/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha dang me tog gis brtan par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de kho na nyid dang las rim bshad pa/ sngags gtad pa/ brtul zhugs gnyis sbyin pa/ rjes gnang*/ lung bstan/ dbugs dbyung rnams so// dang po ni/ rigs kyi bu/ dngos po gcig la du mar snang ba ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor yin la/

de la brten pa'i lha rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi ni mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'o// zhes pa nas/ ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o// zhes ba'i bar sgrub thabs kyi dag pa ltar brjod| gnyis pa las rim ni/ bsrung ba'i dam tshig dang*/ bza' ba'i dam tshig dang*/ gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ srung ba dang*/ phyir zlog dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa dang*/ der slob ma gzhug pa dang*/ rab gnas dang*/ sbyin sreg la sogs pa rnams ni slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i rim pa yin pas khyod kyis 'bad pas sgrubs shig /ces brjod/ gsum pa sngags gtad pa ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal ba'i snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge nyer gnyis pa sogs so so'i sngags kyis bskor ba bla ma'i zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i rna ba g.yas su zhugs pa snying gar nyi ma'i dbus su hūm̐ gnas pa'i tha mar bskor bar bsams la/ yi ge nyer gnyis pa dang*/ yum dang dpa' bo dpa' mo sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi sngags gsum gsum rjes zlos byas rjes/ slob mas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol// gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis/ bcom ldan 'di la bstsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol// zhes me tog 'thor/ bzhi pa brtul zhugs gnyis las/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma rdor sems su bskyed la/ rdo rje hūm̐ dang rdo rje las rdo rje sems dpar gyur pa zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer bsams la/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// dpal he ru ka'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// dpal he ru ka'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hiḥhi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod la/ rdo rje g.yas su gtad/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ slob ma dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal phyag yongs rdzogs yab yum du gsal btab la/

slob dpon gyis yab kyi sngags nyer gnyis pa bzlas pa'i ḍā ma ru slob ma'i lag g.yas/ thod pa g.yon/ tshangs skud phrag pa g.yon/ kha ṭ+wāṃ gru mo g.yon du gtad la/ kha ṭ+wāṃ cang te'u lhung bzed dag |dpa' bos byin pa bslangs nas ni// dpal he ru ka'i phyag rgya 'di// phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas// dpa' bo chen pos bslang bar bgyi// zhes brjod la/ des kyang cang te'u dkrol/ slar slob dpon gyis/ bskyed rdzogs kyi drod thob na/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bde ba chen po zhal phyag gi rnam pa spangs pa'i lha'i sku zhes pa nas/ 'khrid pa la gdon mi za'o zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs kyi spyod pa spyad pa'i skabs ltar brjod do// lnga pa rjes gnang la/ de nas rdo rje can gyi bka' nod par bya ste/ slob dpon gyis/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas// mi bya ba ni gang yang med// de nyid shes nas de nas ni// dpa' bo 'dod pa lnga spyad do// zhes 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos// bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi dngos// de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya// bdag nyid he ru ka mchod bya// zhes lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung chos can// sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no// khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// zhes 'gro don byed pa'i rjes gnang rnams sbyin/ drug pa lung bstan pa ni/ slob dpon sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs kyis g.yon dril bu dang bcas pas chos gos kyi grwa bzung ba'i khu tshur snying khar bcangs shing*| g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i skyabs sbyin bstan la bsgrengs te/ 'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te// 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod// rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang nyid// he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no// oṃ shrī he ru ka ḍā ki nī sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhurbahu waḥswaḥ

'di ltar ngas lung bstan pa'i tshe rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi lha thams cad kyis kyang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par 'gyur ba ste 'di ni chos nyid yin no// zhes brjod/ gong gi he ru ka ces pa'i mal du slob ma'i gsang mtshan gang yin brjod do// bdun pa dbugs dbyung ni/ khams gsum kun gyi rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal ba'i// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes dbugs dbyung*/ des rdo rje slob dpon gyi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang bskur ba thob/ lus kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rdo rje thob rung gi rten 'brel khyad par can mngon du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul lo// gnyis pa gsang dbang gi don du slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ skyob med skyob pa skyabs med skyabs// dpa' chen 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje can// mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar| |gtso bos bdag kyang de 'drar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang na// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis yol ba'i nang du gnas pas/ sa bon lnga'i rigs kyi rang bzhin dag pa'i phyag rgya ni bzhi ste/ las dang*/ chos dang*/ chen po dang*/ dam tshig bzhi gang yang rung ba'i phyag rgyar rdo rje slob dpon snying rje'i stobs yang dag pas/ gnas khang dben par mngon par dga' ba'i lha mo dang yab yum gnyis/ gtso bo la sogs pa'i he ru ka rnams kyi gsang ba sogs yab kyi dang*/ rig ma rdo rje phag mo sogs rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi sogs nas/ āt+ma ko3haṃ gi bar gyis mkha' gsang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar byas la/

yab yum bo la kak+ko la mnyam par sbyar ba'i bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dpa' bo 'khor dang bcas pa byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ dpa' mo thams cad kyang byang sems su zhu ba yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ gnyis ka'i dbu ma'i lam brgyud byang sems kyi ngo bor mkha' gsang du bab pa dung chen du bstsal ba thogs nas/ bu la byang sems lce thog tu 'jog pa la rtog pa mi byed dam zhes dri ba ni/ 'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba gang de myang bar bya// zhes dri/ slob mas/ a hoḥm hā su kha/ zhes rtog pa bcom pa'i lan bya/ de nas de nyid mtheb srin gyis blangs pa bu'i khar bcug la/ ji ltar rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// sngon chad sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// de bzhin du ni byang chub sems// bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro// oṃ hrīḥha ha sogs yab yum gyi nye snying gis sbyin/ slob mas kyang rtog pa bcom la btung*/ de ltar yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar 'dres pa myangs pa las byung ba'i bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin de ni gsang dbang gi ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad la mig dar bsal/ des kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma sbyangs/ lam rang byin brlabs/ rdzogs rim sna tshogs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung rdo rje thob rung gi rten 'brel khyad par can mngon du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ maṇ+ḍal dbul| gsum pa sher dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas pas/ gzung dang 'dzin pa skyob pa'i skyabs// 'khor lo sdom pas bdag skyob mdzod// rnam rtog rmongs pa chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed par// nam mkha' lta bur dri med pa'i// rnam par mi rtog ting 'dzin stsol// gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

gzhung 'dir sngar slob dpon gyis spyad pa'i phyag rgya ma de nyid slob ma la sbyin par bshad pas de ltar ram/ paṇa grub gzhan gyis slob dpon gyi rig ma la bgrod du mi rung bas phyag rgya mtshan ldan gzhan sbyin par bshad pa ltar gang rung gis lag g.yon pa bu'i g.yas su gtad la/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che// mtha' yas bde ba sbyin pa mo// rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya longs// bu yis bla med mchod par gyis// zhes sbyin/ de nas lha mo des/ dpa' bo'i bu bla na med pa la bka' bstsal gyi dri ba ni/ dpa' bo byang chub sems za bar// khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci// rigs lnga las ni rab 'byung ba'i// rig ma mchod pa la gus sam// dri chen dri chu stobs dang khrag /sogs bzar da lta yid ches sam// rjes su mthun smros dam tshig bzang*// ji ltar 'ga' ba smros shig bu// zhes dris par/ slob mas/ 'di ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs// lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro| |bud med rtag gus cis mi bya// pad+ma mchod par cis mi bgyid// ces gsol/ de nas lha mo de dga' ba'i mdangs kyis gos phud skra grol pad+ma rgyas pa bu la bstan nas/ pad+ma bhañdza hoḥ zhes snyoms 'jug la bskul nas| slob ma skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi'i zhes pa nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang du rig ma yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ slar yang bdag nyid he ru ka yab yum du gsal ba'i rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa sogs nas/ rnal 'byor ma bzhi ltar gsal bar gyur gyi bar lus dkyil rgyas pa gsal btab/ de nas/ gtso bo la sogs pa he ru ka rnams kyi gsang ba zhes pa nas/ āt+ma ko3haṃ gi bar gyis mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ yum gyi pad+ma'i dbus na gnas pa'i rtsa bde ba 'bab pa kha kha mu kha sor mos bskul ba bstan la/ bde ba g.yo zhing de'i rtsa sne slob ma'i ro 'dzin gyis yang dag par btsal nas lta ba dang*/

reg pa dang*/ tsum+ba na dang 'khyud pa sogs kyis bde ba bskul ba'i tshe rnam par g.yo ba na snyoms par zhugs nas bde ba kun nas rgyas pa'i tshe rtsa gnas kyi lha yab yum rnams kyang snyoms 'jug mdzad pa'i bde bas rgyud gtams par bsam zhing*/ byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas mgrin par slebs pas dga' ba/ snying khar mchog dga'/ lte bar dga' bral/ rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor son pa 'pho med du bcings pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' bar ngos bzung la/ de'i ngo bo la bskyangs shing slar lte bar dga' ba/ snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan skyes rnams lugs ldog la bslab/ yang bde ba yal na bsrubs pa dang bsrub pa'i sbyor bas gong ltar nyams su blang*/ gal te bde ba cher g.yos nas byang sems 'pho na pad+ma nas lces blang ba sogs dzā lan+dha ra'i khrid rim du bshad pa ltar bya'o// de nas rig ma'i lag g.yon bu'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ deng nas bzung ste bu khyod kyis// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// ji 'drar sems can thams cad kyi// don ni bdag nyid kun gyis byos// zhes rjes su gnang ba byin par bsams/ de ltar rig ma dang snyoms 'jug gi byang sems lte ba nas nor bu'i rtse mor bab pa'i tshe lhan skyes bde ba dang bcas pa'i stong gsal 'dzin pa med pa de ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes te dbang gsum pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes go ba sbyin/ skabs 'dir sher dbang gi rjes 'brel du rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin pa ni/ gzhung gzhan du mi gsal yang grub chen 'di nyid kyi thun mong min pa'i bzhed par gsal bas/ slob dpon gyis bu'i lag tu rig ma gtad nas| 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste// phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o// rigs 'di bor nas de las ni// gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med// rig ma'i brtul zhugs 'di spyod cig /brtul zhugs rnams kyi bla ma'i bla// mtshan med bsam gyis mi khyab pa// 'di la rtag tu gnas par gyis// zhes brtul zhugs sbyin/

gdong g.yogs phye/ de dag gis gsang ba bha ga'i dal du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma sbyangs/ lam nor bu 'gengs pa dang dzā lan+dha ra'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku thugs rdo rje thob rung gi rten 'brel khyad par can mngon du byas so// zhes go ba sbyin/ maṇ+ḍal dbul/ bzhi pa tshig dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gdong g.yogs dang bcas pas/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis// deng bdag bla med bya ba thob// de phyir tshig gi dbang bskur gyis// mgon pos bdag ni grol bar mdzod// gsum gsol/ slob dpon gyis/ dpa' bo kun spyod rim phye bas// man ngag nyid kyis shes par bya// dbang bskur bzhi po bstan rnams kyi// gang tshe brtul zhugs can dbang bskur// bsam med chos ni thob phyir te// de tshe de nyid ces bya 'di// phyi dang nang gi rang bzhin nyid// chos rnams kun gyi ngo bo ste| |bsam gyis mi khyab ces bshad do// snang med rab rdzogs gnas med pa// de nyid lnga pa rdzogs pa'i rim// lhan cig skyes pa mi zad pa// bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas sogs| |de ni brtan g.yo 'gro bdag nyid// bdag med nyid kyis bdag tu gnas// dpa' bo bden pa chen po rtogs// de ltar de dag ni mdor bsdus pa'i tshig tsam ste/ rgyas par rim pa lnga'i rdzogs rim ltar shes par bya ba dag go// de ltar bden pa gnyis mi phyed zung du 'jug pa ni byang chub kyi sems chen po ste dbang bzhi pa'i ngo bo yin no// zhes ngo sprad/ mig dar phye/ de dag gis don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ sgo gsum du 'dzin pa'i dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs/ lam bden gnyis dbyer med bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rdzogs rim bsgom pa dang khyad par gyi dam tshig bzhi bsrung ba la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku ye shes rdo rje thob rung gi rten 'brel khyad par can mngon du byas so// zhes go ba bskyed/

slob mas ci 'byor ba'i yon phul la/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams bsrung bar dam bcas/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid// deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyed kyis slob mar bzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dbul/ gsum pa rjes ni/ grub na tshogs kyi 'khor lo lhag mchod dang bcas pa'ang bya/ bum pa'i lha la mchod cing rkang brgyad kyis bstod la/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ lha mo tshad ma dang*/ bde ba phun tshogs dang*/ dge ba 'di yis khams gsum sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can don kun sogs kyis bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ gtor ma dang lha bshos sogs khyi dang*/ bud med/ bya rog /sprang po sogs la mi sbyin par gang 'os su gshegs/ bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam gyis byin chags par bya'o/ /smras pa/ dril bu zhabs gzhung smin lam gdams pa'i dpyid/ */ mkhas grub du ma'i gsung gi rgyun bzang las// legs bshad bsdus pa'i dngos grub 'dod 'jo 'di// thar 'dod yod na brtson pas len par rigs// sngags gzhung rgya mtsho'i de nyid bsdus pa'i lam// 'gro gang rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon bgyi ba'i// dril bu gzhung gsum nges gsang gdams pa'i srol// skal bzang blo ldan rnams kyi spyad 'os yin// de las byung ba'i dge ba rnams// mar gyur 'gro ba'i phyir bsngo yi// de dag sdom pa'i dbang phyug gi// go 'phang mchog la gnas par shog /de ltar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa dril bu lus dkyil gyi dbang gi chu bo dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba rgya bod kyi mkhas grub du ma'i legs bshad rnams bsdus te bkod pa 'di'ang*/ 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung gi tha shal rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes/

rab byung nag pa zla ba'i dus dge bar lugs gnyis kyi 'dun sa chen po dpal 'bri gung gi pho brang bkra shis tshugs su sbyar ba 'dis kyang rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yun ring du gnas par gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ//
